description: Source file implementing configuration file parsing and reading functions for a network management system, including reading master and slave configurations, log settings, and handling configuration overrides from temporary files.

methods.name: read_log_section
methods.description: Reads and parses the log configuration section from a config file, updating the SConfigLog structure.

methods.name: read_master_config_file
methods.description: Reads and parses the master (controller) configuration file, including log settings, and updates the sConfigMaster structure.

methods.name: read_slave_config_file
methods.description: Reads and parses the slave (agent) configuration file, including log settings, and updates the sConfigSlave structure.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Extracts filename from a given path string.

methods.name: read_config_file
methods.description: Reads a configuration file, parsing key-value pairs within a specified section, supporting override from /tmp directory.
